This '''MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser''' served in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWEVI:ROTJ" />

==History==
[[File:Wingless_MC80_toast.png|thumb|left|200px|The cruiser is destroyed.]]

The ship was part of the [[Rebel Command Fleet]] sent to destroy the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]], but was caught in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|trap]] set for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and was one of several [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], along with the [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], to be destroyed by the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]].<ref name="SWEVI:ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
For a long time fans believed this ship was the [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] from the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|X-wing computer games]]. This was disproved by the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] which states the ''Defiance'' survived the Battle of Endor.
